_comment: Canonical registry of the five Cloudflare agent-economy frameworks this repo records against. The matrix generator reads this so every framework appears in matrix.md even when it carries no tags yet. Slugs are used as the framework= value in CONFORMANCE-TAG markers and as the record filename docs/conformance/<slug>.md.

frameworks.title: Monetization Gateway
frameworks.public_status: Announced 2026-07-01, waitlist, pre-GA. Primary sources S6/S7 retrieved out-of-environment; Gateway rule schema unpublished

frameworks.title: Cloudflare Wallets / cloudflare.pay
frameworks.public_status: Announced 2026-08-04, handle reservation only; funding/spend/API spec unpublished. Press release S9 retrieved out-of-environment

frameworks.title: Web Bot Auth
frameworks.public_status: Spec/docs published; Cloudflare directory registration by application. Primary sources S1–S3 retrieved out-of-environment; signed-agents docs/blog and the S5 architecture-draft body not retrieved

frameworks.title: Content Signals / AI Crawl Control
frameworks.public_status: Generally available; mixed-use crawler default behavior scheduled to change 2026-09-15. S8 (AI Crawl Control) retrieved; Content Signals token vocabulary source not retrieved

frameworks.title: deferred payment scheme (x402)
frameworks.public_status: Proposal stage to x402; proposal body not retrieved
